thread:
maya: Heads up — shipping ETA for the 8 H100 trays moved from 2026-03-26 -> 2026-04-02 due to customs. This affects the canary we planned next week. Need to re-align milestones and ownership. cc @ron @sahil

ron: Thanks — can you paste the updated manifest? Is there any chance partial shipment arrives earlier? We need at least 2 trays for the canary.

maya: Current manifest:
```json
{
  "trays_total": 8,
  "arriving": 4,
  "expected_partial": 2,
  "eta_full": "2026-04-02"
}
```
Customs may release 2 tomorrow but not guaranteed.

sahil: If we get 2 early, we can run a degraded canary with 1 pod per node. We need ops to prep racks and networking. @lina can you confirm rack power availability?

lina: Rack power OK for two nodes in rack-5, spare PDUs staged. Need node images updated with kernel 6.2 fixes before GPU drivers land. @kevin can you pick up the kernel rollout CR?

kevin: On it. I pushed a CRD for review: /diffs/CR-871. Small change to initramfs and nvme drivers. @maya can you schedule a code-review ping for eng-infra?

maya: Done — pinged infra-owners. Also note: Dedicated capacity reservations need to be adjusted — finance needs updated commit counts (we were counting 8, now probably 6). @ops-oncall can you open a reservation adjust ticket?

ops-oncall: Ticket created: INFRA-4021. Assigned to @ron. ETA to update tenant reservations by EOD tomorrow.

ron: ACK. Will update capacity reservations and add routing fallback flag for the canary window (fallback_to_hosted=true).

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout metadata created: canary-plan.json. Canary window tentative: 2026-03-29 10:00 - 12:00 UTC. Notified: eng-runtime, eng-sre.

sahil: Two action items: (1) kevin review + merge kernel CR (2) maya update finance numbers. If customs holds both partials, plan B is simulate load using vCPU-backed nodes. Recommend we prep an A/B test and traffic split.

maya: Agree. I'll contact finance and prep the A/B test playbook here: /playbooks/canary-fallback.md. Will update this thread when finance confirms.

lina: :thumbsup: I can image the nodes tonight once kernel is merged.

kevin: Review submitted and addressed comments. ETA merge ~6 hours.

maya: Thanks all. I'll set a follow-up async check at 18:00 UTC and post results here. If anything urgent DM me. /maya
